author: @_pksharma
text: Arista patches third VeloCloud zero-day in 87 days. Three actively exploited zero-day vulnerabilities have struck Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator between 27 July and 22 October 2026.

author: @cyberkloudck
text: 🚨 Critical PHP Security Alert! Two reported PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619, could expose vulnerable servers to malicious code execution. Update PHP, verify patches & review server logs.

author: @UpwindMDR
text: CRITICAL - Authentication Bypass in Laravel TokenGuard (CVE-2026-114509). Critical improper authentication vulnerability (CVSS 9.2) in Laravel's TokenGuard API guard allows unauthenticated attackers to supply crafted non-string credentials.

author: @ThePHPF
text: Set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 till next PHP release to block an unlikely RCE vector (CVE-2026-115560). Already recommended for CVE-2026-109619 Wed, keep disabled.

author: @agentbeam_
text: Oracle flags a critical Java vulnerability (CVE-2026-91403) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Patch affected versions, review security configurations, monitor suspicious activity.

author: @secpoint
text: Critical GitLab Vulnerability: CVE-2026-110264 (CVSS 10.0). GitLab disclosed a critical flaw on 21 October 2026 affecting self-managed GitLab CE and EE. Under certain conditions, an unauthenticated attacker could execute code through an integer overflow.

author: @UndercodeUpdate
text: Critical Nodejs Security Advisory: Mitigating Ten Core Vulnerabilities Including Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497)

author: @25Gutsu
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP itself, exploited in the wild -> fixed in 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12

author: @RidgelineCyber
text: GitLab 10.0 is one to drop everything for. Unauthenticated RCE on a code host, affected range goes back to 7.0. The Arista VCO one is also actively exploited, but needs a valid account.

author: @0xManan
text: CVE-2026-58455 - Dockwatch (<=0.6.567) unauth RCE. No creds, no bypass tricks, just a chain of lazy mistakes.

author: @sans_isc
text: SANS Stormcast Oct 23, 2026: PHP2Shell Exploitation Update; Signal Call Hang-Up Flaw (CVE-2026-113380); Cisco Snort 3 Critical Vulnerabilities; Linux KSMBD RCE Reports Leaked

author: @AskTheStandard
text: PHP 8.1 and older will never get a fix for PHP2Shell. On 21 October the PHP project fixed CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2). Proof-of-concept exploits are public.

author: @PrevidianCyber
text: Exploitation attempt against our FortiSIEM honeypot decoy, targeting CVE-2026-106173, Fortinet FortiSIEM's path traversal vulnerability. Request matches the file overwrite mode in the Horizon3 PoC.

author: @rst_cloud
text: Critical Vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support Under Active Exploitation (CVE-2026-102764). Actors: UNC5221 (cyber espionage).

author: @BytesNora
text: SecBoard Daily, 22 October 2026. Top story: Siemens Software Center (CVE-2026-110936, actively exploited).

author: @arncof
text: PHP and Node.js shipped critical fixes on Oct 21. PHP: unauth RCE, CVSS 9.2. Node: 10 CVEs, one RCE found by AI. NGINX: 5 CVEs.

author: @aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-114625 in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator using authenticated SQL injection to escalate from low-privilege access to superuser operator level, then pivoted across managed SD-WAN edge devices.

author: @AIFlow_ML
text: In 18 days: LiteLLM shipped a stealer, an npm worm hit an AI-agent SDK, GitHub repos got poisoned workflows, a CA had guessable keys, and BIND patched a DNS RCE.

author: @Rachidmarcil
text: Zero-day alert: Arista patches CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9), a SQL injection in VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem actively exploited in the wild. Any authenticated user, even read-only, can escalate to superuser operator.

author: @lopp
text: Biggest security incidents in the past week: PHP2Shell, two critical RCE bugs in PHP core; eMudhra: eight intermediate certificates had extremely weak private keys due to a key-generation script error.

author: @sunsetwatch26
text: Other critical flaws: Plex Media Server CVE-2026-96652/96654/96655/96656 unauthenticated RCE chain, actively exploited (CISA KEV); SiteGuard Server Edition CVE-2026-106931 command injection to root, exploited (KEV).

author: @morphisec
text: OpenCode MCP Server RCE: Malicious Tool Servers Execute Code on Developer Windows Machines During Sign-In. A critical flaw in OpenCode versions 1.0.137-1.18.32 allows a malicious or hijacked MCP server to execute code.

author: @DarkWebInformer
text: Critical Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection flaw actively exploited. Arista has disclosed CVE-2026-114625, a critical vulnerability affecting on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator deployments. The SQL injection flaw allows any authenticated user to escalate.

author: @cloudsa
text: CISO Daily Briefing: Xinference/Xoscar unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-49950, CVSS 9.8) has a public exploit; auth is opt-in, so set XOSCAR_AUTH_KEY. Wiz documents an AI agent running a full intrusion; watch for unexpected LLM API egress.

author: @BlancheMinerva
text: The PHP exploit (PHP2Shell) was found by AI-enabled defensive operations. There is no evidence of large scale exploitation. This is a huge win for defense running ahead of offensive.

author: @mucaroTM
text: Splunk Enterprise updates address 16 CVEs in product code, including critical CVE-2026-76299 and CVE-2026-76302. Splunk SOAR 8.7.0 fixes 15 product-code vulnerabilities.
